decisions.reason: The product builds directly on the firm's existing plastic processing capabilities, enabling effective learning and improvement, so it is likely to be kept.
PETG thermoforming blank is closely related to the firm's core plastic manufacturing knowledge, supporting assimilation of market feedback and continued development.
UV-curing lacquer is somewhat related to the firm's chemical and coating competences, but its lower website prominence suggests limited learning, so there is a moderate chance of dropping.

Custom hearing protection earmolds require audiological and medical device knowledge distant from the firm's manufacturing base, reducing absorptive capacity and increasing the likelihood of dropping.
